name: github
description: GitHub through its REST API: search, repositories and files, issues and pull requests (diffs, reviews, checks), Actions runs and their logs; opens, comments on, reviews and merges. Reading asks nothing; changes ask first.

token.label: Token
token.help: A personal access token. Empty: GITHUB_TOKEN or GH_TOKEN, else the gh CLI's login; without any, public data only (60 requests an hour).
